page.overview:
What is Battle of Jabo?

The Battle of Jabo was an engagement fought at some point by approximately 180 BBY. In the battle, the Twi'lek Jedi Master Skia Ro of the Jedi Order famously defeated the Sith Darth Kozyr, a fact that was known to Ro's apprentice Christina Starspeeder.

The Battle of Jabo was mentioned in Revenge of the Sis, the 2019 seventh entry in the Star Wars: Jedi Academy non-canon young-reader book series. The book was written by Jarrett J. Krosoczka and Amy Ignatow.
